title: Neon Sky
full_caption: Anthemic 80s-inspired Synthwave and modern Outrun Electropop at 118 BPM in D minor. Bright soaring solo female vocals with crystal-clear English pronunciation and uplifting energy. Punchy retro drum machine kick, classic gated reverb snare, driving sixteenth-note octave synth bass, shimmering Juno-style chorus pads and an unforgettable brassy analog synth lead hook. Opens on an immediate driving synth arpeggio hook, flows through Verse 1 and double Chorus 1 into an energetic analog synth lead instrumental interlude, followed by a tight melodic Verse 2, a soaring Chorus, a rising two-line Bridge, an explosive final Chorus with lush harmonies, and a clean resolving synthwave outro. Keep the lead vocal upfront and articulate.

bgm_b_track.title: Neon_Horizon_BGM
bgm_b_track.caption: Clean modern 80s Synthwave and Outrun electronic instrumental at 116 BPM in A minor, pure instrumental with zero vocals, zero voice chops. Starts immediately on beat one with a catchy bright analog synth brass hook and driving sixteenth-note octave bass arpeggio for the first eight bars, transitions into a smooth focused groove section with warm pulsing synth bass, crisp gated snare and airy analog pads that leave clean midrange space for spoken narration, then rises back into an uplifting bright synth melody finale with a clean musical resolution.
